public_rationale: The general absence-of-demand assertion is contradicted by substantial weekly usage and observed paid business adoption in August 2025. This conclusion does not establish that hundreds of billions in infrastructure investment were justified. That narrower economic concern remains unsettled; there is no supporting outcome evidence here that would warrant a mixed finding.
limitations: OpenAI’s usage figure is self-reported and includes free users.
Ramp measures its observed business population.
If demand means only demand sufficient to earn adequate investment returns, the evidence does not settle that reading.
